name: jme-server-sent-events-secure-scs-ui

scripts.build: npm run check-licenses && npm run generateLicenseFile && ng build --base-href /jme-server-sent-events-secure-scs/
scripts.build-dev: npm run check-licenses && npm run generateLicenseFile && ng build -c development --base-href /jme-server-sent-events-secure-scs/
scripts.build-prod: npm run check-licenses && npm run generateLicenseFile && ng build -c production --base-href /jme-server-sent-events-secure-scs/
scripts.format: npm run lint -- --fix && npm run prettier
scripts.generateLicenseFile: jeap-frontend-license-checker notices && jeap-frontend-license-checker notices --out src/assets/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md --texts folder --texts-dir third-party-licenses

//: These overrides pin transitive dependencies of @quadrel-enterprise-ui to versions that clear the Trivy findings of JEAP-7389; drop them once upstream ships the fixed versions itself. They force versions upstream never declared support for - @quadrel-enterprise-ui/framework asks for uuid ^11 - so bumps here need more scrutiny than a normal dependency update. uuid is ESM-only since v13 and therefore has to stay listed in jest.config.base.js.
